cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallWrenchHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Hold a set of wrenches at a wall
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallWrenchHolder --thickness 5 --burn 0.15 --x 150 --depth 40 --number 8 --min_width 10 --max_width 30 --min_strength 4 --max_strength 6 --extra_distance 3 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallWrenchHolder --thickness --burn --x --depth --number --min_width --max_width --min_strength --max_strength --extra_distance --reference --labels
